text_to_image_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: six-angle head reference for a character library. Generate ONE landscape image, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows of HEAD AND UPPER-CHEST photographs, NOT whole-body portraits. All six feature the same real golden-orange shorthaired tabby cat: round plush cheeks, broad ivory muzzle/chin/chest, delicate orange tabby stripes, large dark olive round eyes, pink nose, white fine whiskers, short upright triangular ears. Wardrobe locked: pale warm-yellow cotton crewneck short-sleeve shirt under blue denim bib overalls, orange-brown stitching, two tan wooden four-hole buttons, chest pocket; small red knitted bow above the cat's anatomical LEFT ear. Bow stays on that exact physical side through rotation; in front view it is on viewer RIGHT, on back view viewer LEFT; in profiles it may be partially occluded naturally. Six directions in reading order: straight frontal; three-quarter nose pointing LEFT edge; three-quarter nose pointing RIGHT edge; true90-degree profile nose pointing LEFT edge; true90-degree profile nose pointing RIGHT edge; exact180-degree back-of-head. Opposite side views must be different; back panel contains no face or eyes. Every panel centered, same camera scale, eye-level, upright neutral attentive pose, entire head, ears and bow uncropped with comfortable margins. Back view includes back of yellow shirt and denim shoulder straps. Genuine cat anatomy and individual fur strands, no human face, no toon or plastic CG. Bright soft diffuse morning light, clean warm ivory softly blurred home/window background, faithful original cream highlights, golden fur, yellow cotton and textured denim. Thin ivory panel dividers; no captions, labels, numbers, text, watermark or UI. No sailor cap or apron.
